ideas.idea: Add complete Dentist/LocalBusiness JSON-LD (address, URL, hours, geo, sameAs) and emit it sitewide
ideas.why: The existing schema has only name and telephone and appears only on /contact, so fuller entity data would help machines understand the business.

ideas.idea: Add detailed team profiles with names, qualifications, registration details and Person schema
ideas.why: team.njk has only a vague 'decades of experience' line with no named clinicians or credentials.

ideas.idea: Replace unsupported claims ('Trusted by thousands', 'decades of experience') with verifiable evidence
ideas.why: Both claims appear in index.njk and team.njk with no supporting evidence.

ideas.idea: Expand the services content with treatment-specific detail, pricing, process and dedicated treatment pages
ideas.why: services.njk is only a four-item list with 'Our prices are simple and clear' and no actual information.

ideas.idea: Wire geo.config.json into the Eleventy build (canonicals, robots, sitemap) or remove it
ideas.why: The config file is not read by .eleventy.js, so its origin and crawler policy have no effect.

ideas.idea: Add a sitewide footer with consistent name, address, phone and opening hours
ideas.why: base.njk has no footer, so the address and phone appear only on /contact.

ideas.idea: Add descriptive internal links to individual treatments, pricing and practitioner pages
ideas.why: This depends on pages that don't exist yet and is standard advice for any site.

ideas.idea: Require or fall back on a description for every page, or omit the tag when it's empty
ideas.why: base.njk always emits the description tag, so a missing description gives an empty tag, and a build-time check or conditional would prevent that.

ideas.idea: Remove data-nosnippet from the insurance terms
ideas.why: The data-nosnippet attribute is a deliberate scoped choice and the report asks to reverse it.

ideas.idea: Add Open Graph and Twitter card metadata
ideas.why: This is standard advice for any site and is mainly about social previews, not ranking.
Having no llms.txt is explicitly not a problem.

ideas.idea: Generate the sitemap from Eleventy collections with lastmod values
ideas.why: This is accurate, but a four-URL static sitemap has little to gain from it.

ideas.idea: Add concise answer-first sections and FAQs to the content
ideas.why: Mandatory FAQs and answer-first formatting for AI answers are folklore, not a requirement.

ideas.idea: Validate the JSON-LD with Google's Rich Results Test after fixing it
ideas.why: This is validation advice that applies to any site with structured data.
